questions.stem: What is the relative formula mass (Mr) of magnesium nitrate, Mg(NO₃)₂? (Ar: Mg = 24, N = 14, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Mg(NO₃)₂ contains 1 Mg, 2 N, and 6 O (the subscript 3 for oxygen is multiplied by the 2 outside the bracket). Mr = (1 × 24) + (2 × 14) + (6 × 16) = 24 + 28 + 96 = 148.
